Zjistilo závažné nedostatky v posouzení stavby, zejména rozpory mezi projektovou dokumentací a odbornými podklady a chybějící posouzení některých zásahů do přírody.
articles.title_en: The Ministry of the Environment has revoked the unanimous opinion on the Hurricanes wind farm.
articles.lead_en: The Ministry of the Environment (MoE) has revoked the consensual single environmental opinion (JES) issued in January this year by the Central Czech Regional Office for a planned wind farm in the Horn of Nymbursk. It has identified serious shortcomings in the assessment of the construction, in particular the discrepancies between the project documentation and expert evidence and the lack of an assessment of certain impacts on nature.
